_comment: Hand-written. Each Svg moves a 20 px square from x=0 to x=100 in 1 s, linear, frozen at the end, so x = min(svgTime / 10, 100). The first Svg is interactive (a sandboxed document), the second an image. The frame at 2000 gives a changed tree (columnGap 2), a redraw, so its Svg clock starts over and x = 0.

props.source: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="200" height="20" viewBox="0 0 200 20"><rect width="200" height="20" fill="#00ff00"/><rect id="interactive" x="0" y="0" width="20" height="20" fill="#ff0000"><animate attributeName="x" from="0" to="100" dur="1s" begin="0s" fill="freeze"/></rect></svg>
